purpose: Values-only check of a Solana payment-channels voucher message against trusted channel terms. The voucher is the 50-byte Ed25519-signed message the payment-channels program reads through the Instructions sysvar: magic bytes 0x56 0x01, a 32-byte channel PDA binding, a u64 little-endian cumulative amount and an i64 little-endian expiry (0 disables). This node recomputes the program validator's own post-signature check sequence by pure byte inspection and trusted inputs: exact 50-byte layout, magic tag/version, channel_id equals the supplied channel PDA, cumulative amount within the escrowed deposit ceiling, cumulative amount strictly above the settled watermark (at-or-below is a stale voucher, mirroring the program's settled >= cumulative failure), expiry 0 or later than the supplied unix clock, and an optional supersession comparison where a second voucher with a lower or equal cumulative amount is superseded by the first. On success it reports the settle delta (cumulative minus settled) a settle of this voucher would add. Values are pasted; every channel term (PDA, ceiling, watermark, clock) is a trusted input computed in BigInt with no floats. Out of scope and stated in every output: the Ed25519 signature itself is NOT verified here and nothing is read from chain; a companion on-chain check or precompile read is required for signature proof. Sibling of the Tempo MPP voucher verifier art-594.
